description: Annual consumer price inflation (HICP, all items) for one European country or the EU / euro area, month by month: the % change in prices against the same month a year earlier. Answers "what is inflation in Germany right now" for travellers, investors, journalists and analysts. Source: Eurostat dataset prc_hicp_minr (HICP, ECOICOP ver.2). Covers EU, EFTA and candidate countries, not the UK or the US; the newest month may be a flash estimate and is flagged. (cost: 1 credit)

geo.description: string, required, 2-letter Eurostat country code (DE, FR, ES, IT, NL, PL, EL = Greece) or country name; EU27_2020, EA (euro area), EA21, EA20 also accepted. EU, EFTA and EU candidate countries only (no UK)

n.description: integer, optional, number of most recent months, 1-100, default 12

name: eu_inflation_rate
